result.title: POKE: Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently for Vision-Language-Action Models
result.summary: Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, but attention-based scores do not directly measure a token's effect on the predicted action. We define action sensitivity as the magnitude of the first-order action change when a token is replaced by its camera's mean token and estimate it for all tokens with a single backward pass. Computing it online is costly: scoring on the full (unpruned) graph needs an extra forward pass at every control step. Scoring on the pruned forward pass is cheaper but causes scoring-graph lock-in: removed tokens lose their direct paths through later layers and tend to receive lower scores, making those locations less likely to return. On replayed observations, even with a random conditioning mask, pruned-graph scoring re-selects 59% of the mask's tokens, versus 6% expected by chance; attention histories show a similar bias. POKE (Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently) computes full-graph action sensitivities offline and distills them into a student with under 0.3M parameters. At inference, the student scores the current observation without backpropagation or previous masks, and score-guided diversity selection retains the tokens. Keeping 32 of 512 visual tokens on LIBERO, POKE achieves 95.2% success on OpenVLA-OFT and 90.8% on $π_{0.5}$ at $1.85\times$ and $1.26\times$ speedups, outperforming attention-, diversity-, and distillation-based pruners, with larger margins on LIBERO-Plus.

AI.brief_summary: POKE 面向 VLA 模型的视觉 token 剪枝，提出以「换成该相机均值 token 时动作的一阶变化」定义 action sensitivity，指出在已剪枝计算图上打分会产生 scoring-graph lock-in（被删 token 后续失去直达路径、分数偏低而难以回归），改为在完整图上离线计算敏感度并蒸馏进不足 0.3M 参数的学生模型，推理时无需反传或历史掩码即可打分并做多样性选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心正是「哪些视觉 token 真正影响输出」的因果式贡献度量与证据筛选，且对剪枝后自评分导致的偏差做了诊断，可供核查是否能用于 LVR 中视觉证据保留与 latent 内容坍缩的判断；但任务为机器人动作预测，与多步推理状态的联系仍需验证。
